title: enginesave export --json
description: Output of `enginesave export ... --json` (0.3.0, D24; paths and excluded_reasons since 0.3.1). Only printed once the archive has been written and verified.

total_bytes.description: uncompressed size of the data files

excluded_sources.description: sources of the snapshot that were left out (see excluded_reasons)

paths.description: anonymized (default): GAME_ROOT/..., RENPY_SAVES_ROOT/... and (0.10.0) UNITY_LOCALLOW/..., LOCALAPPDATA/..., APPDATA/... (0.11.0: DOCUMENTS/..., SAVED_GAMES/..., VIRTUALSTORE/...) instead of this computer's folders; original: --keep-paths

excluded_reasons.description: source id -> private_keys (machine_tokens without --include-tokens) or absolute_path (a folder known only by its absolute path, left out of anonymized exports)
